downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.subtitle: What is stuck in Radarr and Sonarr, why, and what helps.
downloads.subtitle_nex: What is stuck in nexcrate, why, and what helps.
downloads.instanceDown: {{name}} is not answering right now. What is stuck there is shown as it was last seen.
downloads.noInstances: No Radarr or Sonarr is set up yet.

stuck.title: Needs you
stuck.none: Nothing is stuck. Anything that stalls is watched for a while before it shows up here.

running.title: Running
running.noneElse: Nothing else is downloading right now.
running.failed_one: One failed download is no longer running and is left out here.
running.failed_other: {{count}} failed downloads are no longer running and are left out here.

entfernen_neu_suchen.title: Remove and search again?
entfernen_neu_suchen.text: “{{release}}” is taken out of the queue and deleted from the download client together with its data. The release is blocklisted so it does not come back, and Nexview starts looking for another one right away.
entfernen_neu_suchen.warning: The downloaded data is gone afterwards. For a torrent, seeding stops as well.

entfernen.title: Remove only?
entfernen.text: “{{release}}” is taken out of the queue and deleted from the download client together with its data. Nothing is blocklisted, and no new search starts.
entfernen.warning: The downloaded data is gone afterwards. For a torrent, seeding stops as well.

erneut_pruefen.title: Try again?
erneut_pruefen.text: Radarr or Sonarr looks at the finished downloads once more and imports them if the cause has been fixed in the meantime. Nothing is deleted.
erneut_pruefen.text_nex: nexcrate tries again: it checks the download once more or searches anew, whichever it offers. Nothing is deleted.

done.entfernen_neu_suchen: Removed. The search for another release is running.
done.entfernen_ohne_suche: Removed. A new search could not be started; you can start it by hand in Radarr or Sonarr.
done.entfernen_ohne_suche_nex: Removed. A new search could not be started; you can start it by hand in nexcrate.
done.erneut_pruefen: Started. Whether it helped shows in the next round, in about two minutes.
done.import_running: The import is still running. The next round shows the result.
done.import_failed: Radarr or Sonarr reports that the import failed. The message there says more.
done.import_failed_nex: nexcrate reports that the import failed. The message there says more.

import.title: Import manually
import.empty: Radarr or Sonarr finds no file to import in this download.
import.empty_nex: nexcrate finds no file to import in this download.
import.anywayHint: During a manual import, {{instanz}} does not check its objections again. Whatever you select ends up in the library as it is, even a sample.
import.mapping: A different match can be set in the manual import of {{instanz}}.

automation.title: Automation
automation.intro: For some reasons Nexview can act by itself. Out of the box it never does, and every rule applies to its reason only.
automation.limits: At most {{obergrenze}} automatic actions per movie or episode within {{stunden}} hours. After that Nexview stops and notifies you. If the same movie or episode gets stuck {{ab}} times within {{tage}} days, you hear about it as well, even without automation.
automation.never: The automation never does a manual import.
automation.beimWeg: What happens automatically with stuck downloads is up to the procurement itself. Nexview does not act here.
automation.beimWeg_nex: What happens automatically with stuck downloads is up to nexcrate itself. Nexview does not act here.
automation.beimWegMeldet: If the same movie or episode gets stuck {{ab}} times in {{tage}} days, you still get notified.

ergebnis.search_failed: the search could not be started

gefaehrliche_datei.titel: The download contains an executable or dangerous file
gefaehrliche_datei.hilfe: Radarr or Sonarr will not touch that, and rightly so. Blocklist the release, then another one comes.

pfadzuordnung.titel: The download sits at a path Radarr or Sonarr cannot see
pfadzuordnung.hilfe: The download client reports a folder that has a different name or does not exist for Radarr or Sonarr. Usually a remote path mapping is missing under Settings, Download Clients. Try again afterwards.

pfad_ohne_unterordner.titel: The download sits directly in the download folder
pfad_ohne_unterordner.hilfe: Radarr or Sonarr expects a folder of its own for every download. Set the download client to put each download into its own folder.

pfad_in_bibliothek.titel: The download already sits in the library folder
pfad_in_bibliothek.hilfe: The download folder and the library must not be the same folder. Separate them in the settings of the download client.

nicht_gegriffen.titel: Radarr or Sonarr did not grab this download itself
nicht_gegriffen.hilfe: It sits in the category but did not come from a search. Either import it by hand or remove it.

titel_passt_nicht.titel: The name of the download does not match the title
titel_passt_nicht.hilfe: Radarr or Sonarr is not sure the file belongs to the requested title, so it does not import it by itself. A manual import confirms it.

zuordnung_per_kennung.titel: Matched by ID only, not by name
zuordnung_per_kennung.hilfe: The search matched the download to a title, but its name does not fit. A person has to confirm that, with a manual import.

mehrere_treffer.hilfe: Radarr or Sonarr cannot decide which one is meant. The manual import lets you choose.

unbekannter_titel.titel: Radarr or Sonarr does not know the title
unbekannter_titel.hilfe: The download belongs to no movie and no series in the library. Match it by hand or remove it.

nicht_lesbar.titel: The name of the download cannot be read
nicht_lesbar.hilfe: The name does not say which title or episode is meant. Import manually or look for another release.

wird_entpackt.titel: The file is still being unpacked
wird_entpackt.hilfe: This usually sorts itself out. If it takes long, unpacking has stopped in the download client.

datei_gesperrt.titel: The file is locked right now
datei_gesperrt.hilfe: Another program keeps it open, the download client while checking, for example. Try again later.

archiv.titel: The download is an archive and not unpacked yet
archiv.hilfe: Radarr and Sonarr do not unpack. The download client or a tool like Unpackerr has to, then try again.

sample_unklar.titel: Whether the file is only a sample cannot be determined
sample_unklar.hilfe: Radarr or Sonarr cannot read the file. Often it is broken or incomplete. Better look for another release, unless you know the file is fine.

sample.titel: The file is only a sample
sample.hilfe: The release contains a short clip only. Blocklist it, then another one comes.

falsche_endung.titel: The file is not a video Radarr or Sonarr accepts
falsche_endung.hilfe: An image, a text file or an unknown extension, for example. Usually the release should be blocklisted.

keine_tonspur.titel: The file has no audio track
keine_tonspur.hilfe: Such a release is broken. Blocklist it, then another one comes.

teilweise_importiert.titel: Part is imported, the rest is missing from the download
teilweise_importiert.hilfe: What fit is already in the library. The rest is missing or does not belong. The download can go; Sonarr keeps looking for missing episodes afterwards if they are monitored.

kein_upgrade.titel: The download is not better than the existing file
kein_upgrade.hilfe: An equally good or better version is already there. The download can go.

schon_importiert.titel: This file has already been imported
schon_importiert.hilfe: The download is done and only lingers in the queue. It can go.

falscher_inhalt.titel: The download contains something other than what was searched for
falscher_inhalt.hilfe: Radarr or Sonarr does not find the movie or episodes the download was grabbed for. Usually the release should be blocklisted. If the file fits after all, a manual import works.

teilpaket.titel: An incomplete season pack or extras
teilpaket.hilfe: Sonarr does not import such packs by itself. Import what fits manually, or look for a complete release.

folgenzuordnung.titel: Season or episode do not match
folgenzuordnung.hilfe: The numbering in the release differs from how Sonarr counts. The manual import lets you match the episodes.

unvollstaendig.titel: Not everything expected is in the download
unvollstaendig.hilfe: Part of it is missing or could not be imported. Import what is there manually, or look for another release.

mehrteilig.titel: The movie comes in several parts
mehrteilig.hilfe: Radarr does not take movies split across several files. Import manually or look for another release.

kein_platz.titel: There is not enough space on the target
kein_platz.hilfe: Free up space first, then try again.

keine_datei.titel: The download contains no file to import
keine_datei.hilfe: Either the download is empty, still packed or holds extras only, or Radarr or Sonarr cannot see its folder at all. If the path in the message points somewhere that does not exist for Radarr or Sonarr, a remote path mapping is missing. Then do not blocklist; add the mapping and try again.

programm_haengt.titel: The download is not making progress
programm_haengt.hilfe: The download client finds no peers. If nothing happens for a quarter of an hour, usually only another release helps.

magnet.titel: The magnet link cannot be resolved
magnet.hilfe: The download client does not get the description of the torrent, and DHT is switched off there. With DHT it usually works; otherwise look for another release.

programm_fehler.titel: The download client reports an error
programm_fehler.hilfe: The wording below comes from the download client. Often the release is broken, but the client itself can be the cause, such as a full disk. Read the wording first, then decide.

programm_unerreichbar.titel: Radarr or Sonarr cannot reach the download client
programm_unerreichbar.hilfe: Is it running, and are address and credentials right in Radarr or Sonarr? Try again afterwards.

fehlgeschlagen.hilfe: The download client gave up. Look for another release.

programm_unbekannt.titel: The download client reports something Nexview does not know
programm_unbekannt.hilfe: The wording below comes from the download client. Nexview reads these messages in English only; if Radarr or Sonarr is set to another language, they end up here. If the download has been stuck for a long time, another release usually helps.

unbekannt.titel: Nexview does not know this reason
unbekannt.hilfe: The message below is the original wording of Radarr or Sonarr. Nexview does not guess here.

path_not_found.hilfe: nexcrate cannot find the target folder. Does it still exist, and may nexcrate write there?

packed.hilfe: The download contains an archive. nexcrate does not unpack - the download client has to.

file_truncated.hilfe: A video file in the download is shorter than it should be. nexcrate did not file it and replaced nothing. Remove and search again fetches another release.

no_video.hilfe: There is no video file in the download. Usually a sample or a misnamed file.

no_space.hilfe: There is no space left on the target.

gone_from_client.hilfe: The download client no longer knows this job.

client_error.hilfe: The download client reports an error.

import_failed.hilfe: nexcrate could not move the file into place.

dangerous_file.hilfe: The download contains an executable. nexcrate will not touch it.

encrypted.hilfe: The archive is protected by a password.

client_unreachable.hilfe: nexcrate cannot reach the download client right now.

stalled.hilfe: No data has arrived for a while.

files_unassigned.hilfe: nexcrate does not know which episode the files belong to.

other_series_suspected.hilfe: The files look like they belong to a different series.

several_videos.hilfe: There are several video files; someone has to say which one counts.

too_many_files.hilfe: There are more files in the download than expected.

multi_part.hilfe: The download consists of several parts.

no_audio.hilfe: There is no audio file in the download.

album_single_file.hilfe: The album comes as a single file.

album_not_better.hilfe: The downloaded edition is not better than the one already there.

download_failed.hilfe: The download failed and waits for someone to clear it.
